title: 종류를 예측하고 오류 읽기
description: 산다·안 산다 같은 종류를 맞히는 분류 모델을 써요. 정확도만 보지 않고 무엇을 틀렸는지 읽어요. 필수 문제 8개와 선택 도전 2개예요.

tasks.title: 많은 쪽으로 전부 답하는 기준
tasks.goal:
기준 모델은 입력을 보지 않고 정해진 규칙으로만 답해요.
`DummyClassifier(strategy='most_frequent')`는 훈련 y에서 가장 많은 종류로 답해요.
정확도(accuracy)는 맞힌 행의 비율이에요. `accuracy_score(y_test, pred)`로 구해요.

자, 지금 기준 모델은 모든 손님이 산다(1)고 답해요.
먼저 실행해서 예측과 정확도를 보세요.
괄호 안을 `strategy='most_frequent'`로 바꾸고 다시 실행하세요.
정확도를 테스트 y의 0 비율과 견줘 보세요. 앞으로 만들 모델은 이 기준 정확도를 넘어야 해요.

import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
# 이번 문제에 쓸 도구를 불러와요.
from sklearn.dummy import DummyClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score

# 직접 만든 쇼핑몰 방문 자료예요. 실제 고객 자료가 아니에요.
df = pd.read_csv('data/visits.csv')
# visits는 이번 달 방문 수, minutes는 머문 시간(분)이에요.
# cart는 장바구니 상품 수, coupon은 쿠폰을 받았으면 1이에요.
# bought는 다음 주에 샀으면 1, 안 샀으면 0이에요.
y = df['bought']
X = df.drop(columns=['bought'])
# 1의 비율이 두 몫에서 같도록 stratify=y로 나눠요.
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=42, stratify=y)

# 기준 모델이에요. strategy가 답하는 규칙이에요.
base = DummyClassifier(strategy='constant', constant=1)
# 기준 모델도 훈련 자료로 fit해요. 입력 X는 보지 않아요.
base.fit(X_train, y_train)
pred = base.predict(X_test)
print(pred)
# 맞힌 비율인 정확도예요.
acc = accuracy_score(y_test, pred)
print(acc)
# 테스트 정답에서 종류별 비율이에요.
print(y_test.value_counts(normalize=True))

class Inputs(ast.NodeTransformer):
    # Replace only the first prepared assignment to each changed name.
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = values
        self.seen = set()

    def visit_Assign(self, node):
        if len(node.targets) == 1 and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name):
            name = node.targets[0].id
            if name in self.values and name not in self.seen:
                self.seen.add(name)
                node.value = ast.parse(repr(self.values[name]), mode='eval').body
        return node


def execute(text, values):
    tree = ast.fix_missing_locations(Inputs(values).visit(ast.parse(text)))
    scope = {'__name__': '__main__'}
    output = io.StringIO()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(output):
        exec(compile(tree, 'main.py', 'exec'), scope)
    plt = sys.modules.get('matplotlib.pyplot')
    if plt is not None:
        plt.close('all')
    return output.getvalue().rstrip('
'), scope


def same(actual, expected):
    pd = sys.modules.get('pandas')
    if pd is not None and isinstance(expected, (pd.DataFrame, pd.Series, pd.Index)):
        if type(actual) is not type(expected):
            return False
        try:
            if isinstance(expected, pd.DataFrame):
                pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(actual, expected)
            elif isinstance(expected, pd.Series):
                pd.testing.assert_series_equal(actual, expected)
            else:
                pd.testing.assert_index_equal(actual, expected)
            return True
        except AssertionError:
            return False
    np = sys.modules.get('numpy')
    if np is not None and isinstance(expected, np.ndarray):
        # Model and scaler outputs: same shape, and values equal up to float rounding.
        if not isinstance(actual, np.ndarray) or actual.shape != expected.shape:
            return False
        if expected.dtype.kind in 'fc':
            return bool(np.allclose(actual, expected, rtol=1e-7, atol=1e-9, equal_nan=True))
        return bool(np.array_equal(actual, expected))
    if isinstance(expected, float) and isinstance(actual, (int, float)):
        return math.isclose(actual, expected, rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-12)
    try:
        return bool(actual == expected)
    except Exception:
        return False


def fail(message):
    # The learner reads only this message, never the checker's own traceback.
    print(message, file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)


def snapshot(inputs):
    # Files the run created or changed, such as a saved result CSV.
    produced = {}
    for path in Path('.').rglob('*'):
        if path.is_file() and inputs.get(path.as_posix()) != path.read_bytes():
            produced[path.as_posix()] = path.read_bytes()
    return produced


def run_in_fresh_folder(files, text, values):
    # Each run gets its own copy of the data, so files one run writes never help another.
    home = os.getcwd()
    folder = tempfile.mkdtemp(dir=home)
    try:
        os.chdir(folder)
        inputs = {}
        for path, content in files.items():
            target = Path(path)
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_text(content, encoding='utf8')

class Inputs(ast.NodeTransformer):
    # Replace only the first prepared assignment to each changed name.
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = values
        self.seen = set()

    def visit_Assign(self, node):
        if len(node.targets) == 1 and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name):
            name = node.targets[0].id
            if name in self.values and name not in self.seen:
                self.seen.add(name)
                node.value = ast.parse(repr(self.values[name]), mode='eval').body
        return node


def execute(text, values):

    scope = {'__name__': '__main__'}

def same(actual, expected):
    pd = sys.modules.get('pandas')
    if pd is not None and isinstance(expected, (pd.DataFrame, pd.Series, pd.Index)):
        if type(actual) is not type(expected):
            return False
        try:
            if isinstance(expected, pd.DataFrame):
                pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(actual, expected)
            elif isinstance(expected, pd.Series):
                pd.testing.assert_series_equal(actual, expected)
            else:
                pd.testing.assert_index_equal(actual, expected)
            return True
        except AssertionError:
            return False
    np = sys.modules.get('numpy')
    if np is not None and isinstance(expected, np.ndarray):
        # Model and scaler outputs: same shape, and values equal up to float rounding.
        if not isinstance(actual, np.ndarray) or actual.shape != expected.shape:

    if isinstance(expected, float) and isinstance(actual, (int, float)):

    try:

    # Files the run created or changed, such as a saved result CSV.
    produced = {}
    for path in Path('.').rglob('*'):
        if path.is_file() and inputs.get(path.as_posix()) != path.read_bytes():
            produced[path.as_posix()] = path.read_bytes()
    return produced


def run_in_fresh_folder(files, text, values):
    # Each run gets its own copy of the data, so files one run writes never help another.
    home = os.getcwd()
    folder = tempfile.mkdtemp(dir=home)
    try:
        os.chdir(folder)
        inputs = {}
        for path, content in files.items():
            target = Path(path)
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_text(content, encoding='utf8')
            inputs[target.as_posix()] = target.read_bytes()
        output, scope = execute(text, values)
        return output, scope, snapshot(inputs)
    finally:

tasks.goal:
결정트리 분류(`DecisionTreeClassifier`)는 예/아니요 질문으로 자료를 나눠요.
끝 칸(잎)에서는 그 칸에서 가장 많은 종류로 답해요. `max_depth`는 질문을 잇는 최대 횟수예요.
`export_text`는 트리가 만든 질문을 글로 보여 줘요.

먼저 실행해서 질문이 몇 개인지, 어느 열을 묻는지 보세요. `<=` 줄과 `>` 줄 한 쌍이 질문 하나예요.
`class: 1`인 칸이 1이라고 답하는 칸이에요.
`max_depth=1`을 `max_depth=2`로 바꾸고 다시 실행하세요.
질문 수와 1이라고 답한 수, 정확도를 비교해요. 질문을 늘린다고 정확도가 꼭 오르지는 않아요.

class Inputs(ast.NodeTransformer):
    # Replace only the first prepared assignment to each changed name.
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = values

    if pd is not None and isinstance(expected, (pd.DataFrame, pd.Series, pd.Index)):
        if type(actual) is not type(expected):
            return False
        try:
            if isinstance(expected, pd.DataFrame):
                pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(actual, expected)
            elif isinstance(expected, pd.Series):
                pd.testing.assert_series_equal(actual, expected)
            else:
                pd.testing.assert_index_equal(actual, expected)
            return True
        except AssertionError:
            return False
    np = sys.modules.get('numpy')
    if np is not None and isinstance(expected, np.ndarray):
        # Model and scaler outputs: same shape, and values equal up to float rounding.
        if not isinstance(actual, np.ndarray) or actual.shape != expected.shape:
            return False
        if expected.dtype.kind in 'fc':
            return bool(np.allclose(actual, expected, rtol=1e-7, atol=1e-9, equal_nan=True))
        return bool(np.array_equal(actual, expected))
    if isinstance(expected, float) and isinstance(actual, (int, float)):
        return math.isclose(actual, expected, rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-12)
    try:
        return bool(actual == expected)

    print(message, file=sys.stderr)

    produced = {}
    for path in Path('.').rglob('*'):
        if path.is_file() and inputs.get(path.as_posix()) != path.read_bytes():
            produced[path.as_posix()] = path.read_bytes()
    return produced


def run_in_fresh_folder(files, text, values):
    # Each run gets its own copy of the data, so files one run writes never help another.
    home = os.getcwd()
    folder = tempfile.mkdtemp(dir=home)
    try:
        os.chdir(folder)
        inputs = {}
        for path, content in files.items():
            target = Path(path)
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_text(content, encoding='utf8')
            inputs[target.as_posix()] = target.read_bytes()

tasks.goal:
랜덤포레스트(`RandomForestClassifier`)는 트리를 여러 그루 키워요.
그루마다 훈련 행을 무작위로 뽑아 배워요. 예측은 트리들이 투표해서 정해요.
`n_estimators`는 그루 수, `random_state`는 무작위 뽑기를 고정하는 번호예요.

먼저 실행해서 트리 수, 1이라고 답한 수, 정확도를 보세요.
`n_estimators=1`을 `n_estimators=100`으로 바꾸고 다시 실행하세요.
`random_state=42`는 그대로 둬요. 빼면 실행마다 달라질 수 있어요.
1그루일 때와 세 값을 비교해요. 자료에 따라 숲이 1그루보다 못할 때도 있어서 늘 견줘 봐야 해요.

class Inputs(ast.NodeTransformer):
    # Replace only the first prepared assignment to each changed name.
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = values
        self.seen = set()

    def visit_Assign(self, node):

            if name in self.values and name not in self.seen:

    pd = sys.modules.get('pandas')

        if type(actual) is not type(expected):

        try:

                pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(actual, expected)
            elif isinstance(expected, pd.Series):
                pd.testing.assert_series_equal(actual, expected)
            else:
                pd.testing.assert_index_equal(actual, expected)
            return True
        except AssertionError:
            return False
    np = sys.modules.get('numpy')
    if np is not None and isinstance(expected, np.ndarray):

        if not isinstance(actual, np.ndarray) or actual.shape != expected.shape:

class Inputs(ast.NodeTransformer):
    # Replace only the first prepared assignment to each changed name.
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = values

    def visit_Assign(self, node):

            if name in self.values and name not in self.seen:

def execute(text, values):

        try:

            elif isinstance(expected, pd.Series):

            else:

class Inputs(ast.NodeTransformer):
    # Replace only the first prepared assignment to each changed name.
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = values
        self.seen = set()

    def visit_Assign(self, node):
        if len(node.targets) == 1 and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name):
            name = node.targets[0].id
            if name in self.values and name not in self.seen:
                self.seen.add(name)
                node.value = ast.parse(repr(self.values[name]), mode='eval').body
        return node


def execute(text, values):
    tree = ast.fix_missing_locations(Inputs(values).visit(ast.parse(text)))
    scope = {'__name__': '__main__'}
    output = io.StringIO()

    plt = sys.modules.get('matplotlib.pyplot')

    return output.getvalue().rstrip('

def same(actual, expected):
    pd = sys.modules.get('pandas')
    if pd is not None and isinstance(expected, (pd.DataFrame, pd.Series, pd.Index)):
        if type(actual) is not type(expected):
            return False
        try:
            if isinstance(expected, pd.DataFrame):
                pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(actual, expected)
            elif isinstance(expected, pd.Series):
                pd.testing.assert_series_equal(actual, expected)
            else:
                pd.testing.assert_index_equal(actual, expected)
            return True
        except AssertionError:
            return False
    np = sys.modules.get('numpy')

def run_in_fresh_folder(files, text, values):
    # Each run gets its own copy of the data, so files one run writes never help another.
    home = os.getcwd()
    folder = tempfile.mkdtemp(dir=home)

class Inputs(ast.NodeTransformer):
    # Replace only the first prepared assignment to each changed name.
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = values
        self.seen = set()

    def visit_Assign(self, node):
        if len(node.targets) == 1 and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name):
            name = node.targets[0].id
            if name in self.values and name not in self.seen:
                self.seen.add(name)
                node.value = ast.parse(repr(self.values[name]), mode='eval').body
        return node


def execute(text, values):
    tree = ast.fix_missing_locations(Inputs(values).visit(ast.parse(text)))
    scope = {'__name__': '__main__'}
    output = io.StringIO()

    plt = sys.modules.get('matplotlib.pyplot')

def same(actual, expected):
    pd = sys.modules.get('pandas')

        if type(actual) is not type(expected):

        try:

            elif isinstance(expected, pd.Series):

            else:
                pd.testing.assert_index_equal(actual, expected)

    np = sys.modules.get('numpy')

    produced = {}

def run_in_fresh_folder(files, text, values):
    # Each run gets its own copy of the data, so files one run writes never help another.
    home = os.getcwd()
    folder = tempfile.mkdtemp(dir=home)

class Inputs(ast.NodeTransformer):
    # Replace only the first prepared assignment to each changed name.
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = values

            if name in self.values and name not in self.seen:

        return node


def execute(text, values):

class Inputs(ast.NodeTransformer):
    # Replace only the first prepared assignment to each changed name.
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = values

    def visit_Assign(self, node):

            if name in self.values and name not in self.seen:
                self.seen.add(name)

        return node


def execute(text, values):

def same(actual, expected):

    # Each run gets its own copy of the data, so files one run writes never help another.

class Inputs(ast.NodeTransformer):
    # Replace only the first prepared assignment to each changed name.
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = values
        self.seen = set()

    def visit_Assign(self, node):
        if len(node.targets) == 1 and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name):
            name = node.targets[0].id
            if name in self.values and name not in self.seen:
                self.seen.add(name)
                node.value = ast.parse(repr(self.values[name]), mode='eval').body
        return node


def execute(text, values):
    tree = ast.fix_missing_locations(Inputs(values).visit(ast.parse(text)))
    scope = {'__name__': '__main__'}
    output = io.StringIO()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(output):

    plt = sys.modules.get('matplotlib.pyplot')
    if plt is not None:

    return output.getvalue().rstrip('

def same(actual, expected):
    pd = sys.modules.get('pandas')
    if pd is not None and isinstance(expected, (pd.DataFrame, pd.Series, pd.Index)):
        if type(actual) is not type(expected):
            return False
        try:
            if isinstance(expected, pd.DataFrame):
                pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(actual, expected)
            elif isinstance(expected, pd.Series):
                pd.testing.assert_series_equal(actual, expected)
            else:
                pd.testing.assert_index_equal(actual, expected)
            return True
        except AssertionError:
            return False
    np = sys.modules.get('numpy')
    if np is not None and isinstance(expected, np.ndarray):
        # Model and scaler outputs: same shape, and values equal up to float rounding.
        if not isinstance(actual, np.ndarray) or actual.shape != expected.shape:
            return False
        if expected.dtype.kind in 'fc':
            return bool(np.allclose(actual, expected, rtol=1e-7, atol=1e-9, equal_nan=True))
        return bool(np.array_equal(actual, expected))
    if isinstance(expected, float) and isinstance(actual, (int, float)):
        return math.isclose(actual, expected, rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-12)
    try:
        return bool(actual == expected)
    except Exception:
        return False


def fail(message):
    # The learner reads only this message, never the checker's own traceback.
    print(message, file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)


def snapshot(inputs):
    # Files the run created or changed, such as a saved result CSV.
    produced = {}
    for path in Path('.').rglob('*'):
        if path.is_file() and inputs.get(path.as_posix()) != path.read_bytes():
            produced[path.as_posix()] = path.read_bytes()
    return produced


def run_in_fresh_folder(files, text, values):
    # Each run gets its own copy of the data, so files one run writes never help another.
    home = os.getcwd()
    folder = tempfile.mkdtemp(dir=home)
    try:
        os.chdir(folder)
        inputs = {}
        for path, content in files.items():
            target = Path(path)
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_text(content, encoding='utf8')
            inputs[target.as_posix()] = target.read_bytes()
        output, scope = execute(text, values)
        return output, scope, snapshot(inputs)
    finally:
        os.chdir(home)
        shutil.rmtree(folder, ignore_errors=True)

    parts += [path + ' 내용' for path in case.get('files', {})]
    return ', '.join(parts)
